title_as_printed: Experimental and predicted water contents, in ppmV, for natural gas in equilibrium with free water or hydrates at 283.1 K(+-0.1 K).

value.what: water content of the gas in ppmV (volume ppm; mole/volume basis not stated, ideal-gas equivalence assumed by the method), measured via frost-point temperature at atmospheric pressure

row_regime_overrides.reason: Phases present column: Vapour/hydrate for the four highest pressures; rows 0-2 Vapour/liquid (regime empty)

conversion_needs: ppmV to mole fraction if mole basis (not stated)
notes: Gas is a multicomponent natural gas (Table 3 of the paper, GC mole %), not in the seven-gas set; builder decides. 'Phases present' column is printed as a bracket across rows (Vapour / liquid on rows 0-2, Vapour / hydrate on rows 3-6); the slash character sits on its own rows 1 and 4.
quality_remarks: ppmV is taken as mole ppm (ideal gas at atmospheric pressure); the paper never states mole or volume basis but derives the water content from the frost-point temperature at atmospheric pressure. P is the equilibrium-cell pressure measured with a strain-gauge transducer (absolute vs gauge not stated). Transducer range quoted 0-41 MPa while Table 5 reaches 56.84 MPa. Row 6 (13.97 MPa) has a blank phase cell; the hydrate regime for it is inferred from the vapour/hydrate bracket.
